question:
**Select the correct option to fill in the blank.**

She couldn’t eat the________ pizza by herself
solution:
The correct answer is **'whole'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Since we need to select the correct homonym from the given options, we can negate the word **heal **as it is not a homonym for the other words. 
 
• Let us look into the meaning of the given homonyms - 
 
 
• **whole - **all of; entire. - *He spent the **whole **day sleeping.*
 
• **hole - **a hollow place in a solid body or surface. - *The dog had dug a **hole **to hide the bone. *
 
• **haul - **(of a person) pull or drag with effort or force. - *We need to **haul **the boat out of the water. *
 
 
 
• The given blank needs a word that would describe how the subject (she) was unable to finish a full pizza by herself. 
 
• From the above meanings it is clear that **whole **is the correct homonym for the given blank. 
 
• Hence, **option 1 **is the correct answer. 

**Correct sentence__ - ***She couldn’t eat the **__whole__ **pizza by herself.*
